en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor outflow-free (*na-kusalaṃ no-āsavaṃ dhammaṃ*) … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition (*hetu*), twenty-nine; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*), twenty-four … pe … under the result condition (*vipāka*), nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor outflow-free … Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor with-outflows (*na-sāsavaṃ*) … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition, seventeen … pe … under the repetition condition (*āsevana*), nine … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, seventeen.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with taints … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with taints … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-four; under the object condition, seventeen … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-four.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor dissociated from taints … [End of section].

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor with-outflows (*anāsava*) and not without-outflows (*anāsava*) … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition (*hetu*), twenty-nine; under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*), twenty-four … pe … under the result condition (*vipāka*), nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), twenty-nine.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome, nor without-outflows, and not with-outflows … Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome, nor without-outflows, and dissociated from outflows (*āsavavippayutta*) …
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome, nor dissociated from the taints (*āsava*), and is itself not a taint...

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome, dissociated from the taints, and is itself not a taint... (Abbreviated. Under the root condition (*hetu*) there are seventeen... pe... under the repetition condition (*āsevana*) there are nine... pe... under the ripening condition (*vipāka*) there are nine... pe...

under the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*) there are seventeen. Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome, dissociated from the taints, and is itself not a taint... (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are twenty-four, under the object condition (*ārammaṇa*) there are seventeen... pe... under the ripening condition there are nine... pe... under the non-disappearance condition there are twenty-four.
